approve-purchase-order.description: A department manager approves a purchase order for fulfillment
approve-purchase-order.businessGoal: authorize spending and ensure procurement compliance

approve_purchase_order.description: The purchase order is approved and sent to the supplier

approver_authorized.description: The approver has authority over this department and amount
scenarios: A manager from a different department tries to approve the PO

purchase_order_pending_approval.description: The purchase order is in pending approval state
scenarios: Manager tries to approve an already approved PO

auto-approve-purchase-order.description: The system automatically approves purchase orders below the auto-approval threshold
auto-approve-purchase-order.businessGoal: streamline low-value purchases by auto-approving below threshold

approve_purchase_order.description: The purchase order is automatically approved without manager intervention

amount_below_threshold.description: The purchase order amount is below the auto-approval threshold
scenarios: PO for $500 when threshold is $1000 — auto-approved
PO for $5000 when threshold is $1000 — skipped, requires manual approval

cancel-order.description: A customer cancels an order that has not yet been confirmed
cancel-order.businessGoal: avoid being charged for unwanted products

cancel_order.description: The order is cancelled and any held resources are released

order_not_yet_confirmed.description: The order has not been confirmed yet
scenarios: Customer tries to cancel after receiving confirmation email

order_not_yet_cancelled.description: The order has not already been cancelled
scenarios: Customer tries to cancel an order that was already cancelled

confirm-order.description: The system confirms a submitted order after verifying payment and stock

order_confirmed.description: The order is confirmed and ready for fulfillment

scenarios: Credit card is declined
Payment gateway timeout

stock_unavailable.description: One or more products are out of stock
scenarios: Last unit was purchased by another customer moments before

order_confirmed.description: The order status transitions to confirmed
Payment has been charged to the customer
Inventory is decremented for the ordered items

create-order.description: A customer creates a new order by selecting products

create_order.description: A new order is created in draft state with the selected products
scenarios: Customer with complete profile selects two available products

customer_info_provided.description: The customer has provided required contact and shipping information
scenarios: Customer submits order without a shipping address
Customer has no email on file

products_available.description: All selected products exist and are available for sale
scenarios: Customer selects a discontinued product

create-purchase-order.description: A procurement officer creates a purchase order to request goods from a supplier
create-purchase-order.businessGoal: acquire necessary materials from approved suppliers within budget

create_purchase_order.description: A new purchase order is created in pending approval state

supplier_selected.description: A valid and active supplier has been selected
scenarios: Officer tries to create a PO without selecting a supplier

budget_available.description: The department budget can accommodate the purchase order total
scenarios: Officer requests materials that would push the quarterly budget over limit

fulfill-order.description: The system initiates fulfillment for a confirmed order

fulfill_order.description: The order is queued for picking, packing and shipping

order_ready_for_fulfillment.description: The order is in confirmed state and ready to be fulfilled
scenarios: System tries to fulfill an order that was cancelled after confirmation

initiate-confirmation.description: The system automatically initiates confirmation for a submitted order
initiate-confirmation.businessGoal: automatically process submitted orders for payment and stock verification

confirm_order.description: The system begins payment and stock verification

order_is_submitted.description: The order is in submitted state
scenarios: System receives a duplicate submission event for an already confirmed order

notify-order-confirmed.description: The system sends a confirmation notification and logs the event
notify-order-confirmed.businessGoal: keep customers informed and maintain audit trail for confirmed orders

notify_order_confirmed.description: The system sends customer notification and creates audit log entry

order_is_confirmed.description: The order is in confirmed state
scenarios: System receives duplicate confirmation event

process-approve-purchase-order.description: The system processes the approval and notifies the supplier

purchase_order_approved.description: The purchase order is approved and the supplier is notified
scenarios: Manager approves a PO and supplier receives notification

approval_processing_error.description: The approval could not be processed due to a system error
scenarios: Supplier notification service is unavailable

purchase_order_approved.description: The purchase order status transitions to approved
The supplier is notified of the approved purchase order

process-cancel-order.description: The system processes the cancel order intent and releases held resources

order_cancelled.description: The order is cancelled and all held resources are released
scenarios: Customer cancels a draft order with no payment hold

order_not_cancellable.description: The order is in a state that does not allow cancellation
scenarios: System receives cancel intent for an order already in fulfillment

order_cancelled.description: The order status transitions to cancelled
Any pending payment authorization is voided
Reserved inventory is released back to available stock

process-create-order.description: The system processes the create order intent and persists a new order

order_created.description: A new order is persisted in draft state
scenarios: Customer creates an order with two valid products

invalid_order_data.description: The order data is malformed or contains inconsistencies
scenarios: Product quantity is negative
Customer reference points to a deleted account

order_created.description: The order is persisted with status draft
The order contains the selected products as line items
The order is linked to the customer who created it

process-create-purchase-order.description: The system processes the create purchase order intent and persists a new PO

purchase_order_created.description: A new purchase order is persisted in pending approval state
scenarios: Officer creates a PO for office supplies within budget

invalid_purchase_order_data.description: The purchase order data is malformed or contains inconsistencies
scenarios: PO references a supplier that has been deactivated since validation

purchase_order_created.description: The purchase order is persisted with status pending approval
The requested amount is reserved against the department budget
The purchase order references the selected supplier

process-fulfill-order.description: The system fulfills the order by picking, packing and shipping

order_fulfilled.description: The order is fulfilled and shipped to the customer
scenarios: All items are in stock and successfully shipped

fulfillment_failed.description: The order could not be fulfilled due to a logistics issue
scenarios: Warehouse reports damaged goods for an item in the order
Shipping provider rejects the delivery address

order_fulfilled.description: The order status transitions to fulfilled
Physical stock is decremented for shipped items

process-order-notification.description: The system sends a confirmation email to the customer and logs the order event for audit

customer_email_sent.description: A confirmation email is sent to the customer
scenarios: Customer receives order confirmation with tracking details

order_audit_logged.description: The order confirmation is logged for audit purposes
scenarios: Audit system records the confirmation timestamp and order details

notification_failed.description: The notification could not be sent due to a system error
scenarios: Email service is down
Customer email address is invalid

customer_email_sent.description: The confirmation email has been sent to the customer

order_audit_logged.description: An audit log entry is created for the order confirmation

process-reject-purchase-order.description: The system processes the rejection and releases the budget reservation

purchase_order_rejected.description: The purchase order is rejected and the budget reservation is released
scenarios: Manager rejects a PO and budget is freed up

rejection_processing_error.description: The rejection could not be processed due to a system error
scenarios: Budget release service is unavailable

purchase_order_rejected.description: The purchase order status transitions to rejected
The reserved budget amount is released back to the department

process-route-order.description: The system routes the order to express or standard fulfillment based on shipping preference

order_routed_express.description: The order is routed to the express fulfillment channel
scenarios: Customer chose next-day delivery
Customer chose 2-day shipping

order_routed_standard.description: The order is routed to the standard fulfillment channel
scenarios: Customer chose free standard shipping
No shipping preference specified — defaults to standard

routing_failed.description: The order could not be routed to any fulfillment channel
scenarios: Shipping destination is not serviceable by any carrier
All fulfillment centers are at capacity

order_routed_express.description: The order route is set to express fulfillment
The order status transitions to routed

order_routed_standard.description: The order route is set to standard fulfillment
The order status transitions to routed

process-submit-order.description: The system processes the submit order intent and transitions the order to submitted

order_submitted.description: The order transitions to submitted and is queued for confirmation
scenarios: Customer submits a valid draft order with two items

invalid_order_data.description: The order data is inconsistent at submission time
scenarios: Order was modified concurrently and is now in an invalid state

order_submitted.description: The order status transitions to submitted
The order can no longer be modified by the customer

reject-purchase-order.description: A department manager rejects a purchase order

reject_purchase_order.description: The purchase order is rejected and the budget reservation is released

rejector_authorized.description: The rejector has authority over this department
scenarios: A manager from a different department tries to reject the PO

purchase_order_not_yet_rejected.description: The purchase order has not already been rejected
scenarios: Manager tries to reject a PO that was already rejected

route-order.description: The system determines the shipping route for a submitted order
route-order.businessGoal: route orders to the appropriate fulfillment channel

route_order.description: The order is queued for routing based on shipping preference

order_is_submitted.description: The order is in submitted state and ready for routing
scenarios: System receives a routing request for an already routed order

submit-order.description: A customer submits a draft order for processing
submit-order.businessGoal: proceed with the purchase and receive the goods

submit_order.description: The order transitions from draft to submitted and is queued for confirmation

order_has_items.description: The order contains at least one line item
scenarios: Customer tries to submit an order after removing all products

order_in_draft.description: The order is in draft state and has not been submitted yet
scenarios: Customer double-clicks the submit button
